about_the_game: The Goldenheart OST contains all 37 individual tracks included in the game. Although the original in-game tracks are sometimes more than 20 minutes in length, we've cut them down to preserve the "essence" of each track. The total playtime is about 1 hour and 40 minutes and the order of the songs mimic the progression of the game. All music was created in-house by the Millenniapede Audio Video Club specifically for Goldenheart. A large portion of the music was created with a modular synthesizer built by the MAVC. Some was created using sampled acoustic instruments, a DX7 style softsynth, and a real acoustic guitar.
